ops.old: Studies by Ethan Basch and colleagues published in JAMA and the New England Journal of Medicine demonstrated
ops.new: A randomized trial by Ethan Basch and colleagues, published in the Journal of Clinical Oncology (2016) with survival results in JAMA (2017), demonstrated
ops.claim: Basch symptom-monitoring studies "published in JAMA and the New England Journal of Medicine"
ops.sources: Basch E et al., J Clin Oncol 2016;34(6):557-65 (fewer ED visits, better QoL); Basch E et al., JAMA 2017;318(2):197-8 (overall survival 31.2 vs 26.0 months); Denis F et al., JAMA 2019 (replication in lung cancer)
ops.note: Findings real; NEJM venue was wrong.

ops.claim: PROMIS NIH 2004/HealthMeasures; HOOS JR/KOOS JR in CJR since 2016 and IQR THA/TKA PRO-PM; FDA June 2021 draft guidance on core PROs; EOM ePRO requirement
ops.sources: HealthMeasures (Northwestern); CMS CJR and IQR THA/TKA PRO-PM pages; FDA draft guidance June 2021; CMS EOM overview (ePRO implementation)
